description: Pre-payment check for one wallet address: a short yes/no for an agent or payment flow that is about to send funds. Returns decision block, no_exact_match or invalid_address, whether the address is listed, the listed entity and programs when it is, the OFAC SDN list date and hash, a screening_id and a signature reference. It uses the same exact-match lookup as wallet_screen, so the two never disagree. no_exact_match means the address is not on the list checked; it is not a clearance. Use wallet_screen for several addresses, other lists or a report. Price without an account: $0.005 per call.

address.description: The wallet address you are about to pay.

asset.description: Optional asset or network ticker such as ETH, USDC, XBT or TRX. It is recorded in the result as requestedAsset and never changes the decision: an address listed under any asset is a block. Letters and digits only, 2 to 10 characters.

response_detail.description: summary (default) returns a one or two sentence summary to the model; full returns the full JSON as text. The structured result is the same either way.

name: wallet_payee_check

accepts.description: Present when payment is needed: the x402 payment requirements to sign.

assetMatched.description: Only when asset was given: true when the list names this address under that asset, false when it does not (a listed address is still a block).

bucket.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: the limit that was reached.

data.description: The signed copy of the result fields, for screening_verify.

decision.description: block when listed, no_exact_match when not listed, invalid_address when the address is not a recognized format.

entity.description: The listed party, when decision is block.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when the tool fails.

limit.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: the daily limit.

listVersion.description: Which version of the list was checked.

publishedAt.description: Publication date of the list file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the list file.

listed.description: True when the address is an exact match on the list.

notAClearance.description: Always true. no_exact_match is not a clearance.

otherEntities.description: How many other listed parties share this address, when more than one does.

payer.description: Present when a payment was refused: the paying address.

price.description: Present when payment is needed: the price of the call without an account.

programs.description: Sanctions programs the listed party is under, when decision is block.

remaining.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: how much was left.

requestedAsset.description: The asset you named, uppercased. It is your own input, recorded as sent. It never changes the decision.

resetsAt.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: when it resets (ISO 8601).

retryAfterSeconds.description: Present when the account made too many calls: seconds to wait.

signature.description: Reference to the signature in provenance.

support.description: Present on some errors: where to get help.

used.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: how much of it was used today.

x402Version.description: Present when payment is needed: the x402 protocol version.

title: Wallet Payee Check
